# Gong: Renewal and Cancellation Guide (as of 2026-11-17)

## Default renewal behaviour
- **Auto-renews for one year.** Gong's public Terms and Conditions say that, 
except as otherwise specified in an Order Form, subscriptions automatically renew for additional one-year periods unless either party gives the other written notice (email acceptable) at least 60 days before the end of the relevant subscription term.
 (Source: gong.io/legal/terms-and-conditions, §3.3.)
- **Promotional pricing ends at renewal.** 
Unless the Order Form says otherwise, renewal of promotional or one-time priced subscriptions is at Gong's list price in effect at the time.

- **Third-party summaries agree on 60 days.** 
ZoomInfo's pricing overview says subscriptions auto-renew for one-year periods unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.
 
Avoma gives the same default.

- **Conflicting claims.**
  - 
Oliv.ai says "60-90 day" notice.

  - 
Tropic says the default is 30 days.

  - Neither matches Gong's published terms above. Treat 60 days as the public default and defer to your Order Form.

## Notice window
- **Public default:** at least 60 days before the end of the current subscription term (§3.3 above).
- **Your actual deadline:** Not verified. Confirm it in your signed contract, because the Order Form can override it.

## How to give notice
1. **Check your Order Form first.** It may set a different term, notice period or method. 
The 60-day default applies "except as otherwise specified in an Order Form."

2. **Calculate the deadline.** Count back at least 60 days from the term end date. Add buffer for delivery time.
3. **Send written notice by a valid method.** Gong's terms say 
notices to Gong are valid only if sent by pre-paid first-class certified mail or overnight courier to Gong, attn: Chief Legal Officer, P.O. Box 190250, San Francisco, CA 94119, or to an email address given in the terms, or another address Gong authorizes.

   - The email address is hidden in the official page text I retrieved. One non-production mirror of the page shows legal@gong.io (
same P.O. Box and email listed there
). I could not confirm it on Gong's production page, so mark it **Not verified — confirm in your signed contract or with the vendor.**
   - The renewal clause says email is acceptable, but the general notice clause lists mail, courier or the stated email. It is not clear how these fit together. Send by a method that satisfies both, and keep proof of delivery. Confirm with Gong in writing.
